name: Paper Fold
description: The first clip folds in half in 3D like a sheet of paper, then in half again, and the folded packet flies off, leaving its shadow on the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the folded packet flies off (x right, y up)

params.name: tilt
params.description: How much the sheet tilts and recedes while it folds

params.name: shading
params.description: How much the faces darken as they turn, and their shadows

params.name: paper
params.description: Color of the back of the paper
